home.intro1: I'm JP, a software engineer and technical lead near Québec City. For 15+ years I've built <mark>mobile apps</mark>, <mark>web platforms</mark> and the <mark>cloud plumbing</mark> underneath them — for startups, a research hospital (CRIUCPQ), a real-estate platform I co-founded, and Ticketmaster.
home.intro2: I'm most useful where product, design and engineering meet: I'll sit with you to figure out what's worth building, then <mark>build it</mark>, then make sure it <mark>stays up</mark>. Day to day that's Next.js, React, React Native, TypeScript and Postgres; Go, Rails, Java and AWS when the job calls for them.
home.intro3: I work with small and mid-size teams in tech, real estate and finance — as your <mark>first engineer</mark>, a <mark>fractional CTO</mark>, or the person who finally migrates the thing everyone's afraid to touch.

resume.title: Résumé
resume.description: Fractional CTO and senior software engineer, 15+ years. Technical co-founder, protocol engineer, consultant inside Ticketmaster's live-event systems. Remote from Québec.
resume.intro: The formal version. It prints cleanly if you need a copy.
resume.name: Jean-Philippe Melanson
resume.availability: Part-time · remote from Québec · travel when it matters
resume.overviewText: I'm the engineer companies hand the critical path to. In 15 years I've been technical co-founder of a real-estate platform, the de-facto backend owner at a $200M-valuation delivery startup, a consultant inside Ticketmaster's live-event systems, and a senior engineer on the data protocol that shipped its token launch to a platform of a million users. I work autonomously, ship on the date I gave you, and tell you the truth about scope, risk and cost — early. Since 2024 I ship with AI coding agents and set teams up to do the same.
resume.how1V: Estimates, risks and bad news arrive early and in plain language.
resume.how2V: If I committed to Friday, it ships Friday.
resume.how3V: Give me the goal and the constraints; I bring the plan, the code and the ops.

resume.outcome1D: Architecture, product and infrastructure from zero to MVP; onboarded the first 10–20 paying customers.

resume.outcome4T: CRIUCPQ — led development of a scientific app for a research hospital, from two native apps to one React Native codebase and the web.
resume.outcome4D: Roughly halved the yearly maintenance effort: one language, one release train, both stores plus web.
resume.outcome5T: FastAF — carried the backend and end-to-end delivery of core commerce and crypto-payment features.
